quantity.multiplicity: 0..n entries per atom; parameterId unique within atom. Role is not a unique key: multiple materials, phases, scopes, planned/actual values or conflicting source readings remain distinct entries. Never overwrite or coalesce entries by role or unit. Empty means no quantities alleged; a required profile quantity must still be present and STATED.
quantity.material: PRESENT requires materialRole and exact binding. NOT_APPLICABLE needs an explicit process quantity reason (for example equipment speed). UNREPORTED retains missing source identity and cannot satisfy a comparison requiring material identity. OTHER_MATERIAL requires an exact material definition. No role-based inference of identity.
quantity.basis: PRESENT requires quantityKind, unit, exact decimal and basis subject/material binding. Ratio basis is independent of numerator material. NOT_APPLICABLE is only for non-ratio quantities; UNREPORTED is retained but cannot satisfy a basis-dependent comparison. A wet/dry mass basis is explicit, never inferred from percent.
quantity.value: STATED stores quantityKind, unit, decimal, qualifier, unitProfile and original {presence, lexicalValue, unitText, sourceBinding, sourcePointer}; absent original lexical/unit data is explicit. Optional normalized {quantityKind, unit, decimal, conversionBinding} coexists with original; conversion must be admitted for exact material/basis. UNREPORTED stores reason and asserts no numeric value. No zero, plan substitution or silent normalization.
quantity.scope: Every entry repeats exact activityInstance and appliesTo {target, extent, subjectTime, processPoint, phase}. These must equal or explicitly be a proved subextent/time of that atom; no quantity transfers to a sibling activity. Timing intervals are parameter assertions, never a temporal-basis fallback.
quantity.comparison: Select entries by parameterId and full role/material/basis/posture/scope tuple; compare all claimed values/qualifiers with the designated source entries. A change in flow does not change product rate but does contradict the flow allegation. Compare normalized values only with the bound conversion; missing identity/basis is indeterminate, conflicting claimed value fails the chosen comparison.
quantity.fieldReferences: Row quantity fields contain only {quantityParameterId}. Resolve exactly one entry in this atom, with the row-defined role/material/posture. Standalone scalar quantity fields are not permitted in current operation bodies. Compliance operands retain their own quantity contract and may reference exact operation parameter IDs with their scope.

MIXTURE_AS_APPLIED.definition: The exact applied mixture has its own immutable identity and definition, separate from its named constituent product and carrier identities. components records each constituent materialRole and binding from that definition; no component is silently the whole mixture. At least two distinct constituent bindings are required for this mixture form.

AS_IDENTIFIED_MATERIAL.definition: The quantity applies only to this exact identified material in its declared role. PRODUCT is the identified product as supplied; WATER or CARRIER is that named component volume. OTHER_MATERIAL additionally requires its exact materialDefinition. This form does not assert the volume of a product-plus-carrier mixture.

UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_MATERIAL.definition: Retain the reported quantity and original source fields when material identity was not reported/resolved. material.presence is UNREPORTED. This is an explicit incomplete disclosure, not an assertion about an identified mixture/component and cannot satisfy a material-specific comparison.

identityRules: A positive material-specific application-volume comparison requires material presence PRESENT, exact binding and the matching interpretation; material identity cannot be erased to avoid a mismatch. UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_MATERIAL retains known numeric/source data but yields an unresolved material comparison.

MIXTURE_AS_APPLIED binding must differ from every constituent binding; the mixture definition and component roles must agree with source evidence. components is a closed list of role/binding pairs for the identified recipe/composition revision, not an unbound display label.

CARRIER_VOLUME remains a separate parameter role about the identified carrier. No role/unit coincidence proves it equals application volume, and no product-plus-carrier summation is performed without an explicit supported calculation.
UNREPORTED numeric value does not invent a material identity or mixture; any missing-material disclosure retains its unresolved comparison status.
applicationVolumeMaterialContract.sourcePreservation: The pinned SPRAY_MACHINE /actualQuantityParameters/1 is APPLICATION_VOLUME, materialRole WATER, material:water, 200 L/ha. Its faithful interpretation is AS_IDENTIFIED_MATERIAL/WATER. The separate W14 mixture example is fictional and is not a reinterpretation of those source bytes.
applicationVolumeMaterialContract.rowAlias: O01.parameters.applicationVolume resolves its same-atom quantityParameterId, requires APPLICATION_VOLUME and then this discriminated material contract. It has no fixed CARRIER-only constraint.

predicates: Require start < end and exact endpoints equal to the explicitly designated body window or intent payload intendedTimeWindow.

A designated intent payload must have PRESCRIPTION_WINDOW/PLANNED_WINDOW or the unique exact versioned interpretation of omitted/UNKNOWN under currentProposedQualifierRules. Reject execution/observation time as intent.

Facet is the requested milestone for the named activity/work specification in this window, not evidence it already happened. Preserve planned/target quantities separately from any historical comparison values.
An event is prohibited by retained v0.1 INTENDED_WINDOW rule. No instant observation, subjectTime.at, or already produced result/ingested record is required.
Require designated MeasurementEvidence phenomenonTime.timeType INSTANT and exact /phenomenonTime/instant == subjectTime.at. No resultTime, sourceCapturedAt, recordTime or interval endpoint fallback.

The exact activity/facet, work, target, extent, performer and property/result/method/qualifier interpretation must agree; occurrence definitions apply only to this profile. Collection may use separate provenance with an unchanged ABSENT_PENDING assay, never manufacture an occurrence result.

With event absent, evaluate all same measurement and relationship predicates. With event present, independently require exact body case, Event Ingress, and fixed compatible selector from eventTime/observationTime/decisionTime/effectiveFrom equal to at; equal timestamp/family is insufficient.
Require start < end and exact endpoints equal to the designated body interval or execution payload effectiveTimeInterval. Optional payloads are not made mandatory by this branch.

Designated execution payload uses EXECUTION_INTERVAL/EFFECTIVE_INTERVAL; OBSERVED_INTERVAL requires the exact method to establish the full action interval. Omitted/UNKNOWN requires its unique versioned interpretation. Planned windows cannot prove performance.

OCCURRENCE alleges the activity over this declared interval; STARTED asserts the work start condition at start and the described interval; IN_PROGRESS asserts progress throughout the stated interval under the method; COMPLETED requires all finish conditions satisfied by end over the specified extent. An interval end alone is not completion evidence.

Event absent retains the same allegation/evidence rules. Event present requires the exact body case and both effectiveFrom == start and effectiveUntil == end, plus Event Ingress and target/extent compatibility. Missing event end cannot be invented.
Supporting interval/instant measurements may supply evidence but do not replace the designated temporal source or collapse an interval to subjectTime.at.

rowSpecializations.O10: The act is collection of the exact sample under the bound sampling procedure. STARTED is commencement of specimen collection, not ordering a test; IN_PROGRESS is actual ongoing collection/assembly of that specimen. Finish is completion of the specified specimen/support collection, independent of analysis availability.
rowSpecializations.O16: The act is communicating the exact allegation by the stated channel. STARTED is commencement of that communication, IN_PROGRESS is its ongoing transmission, COMPLETED is delivery/recording under the bound reporting procedure; none is the reported physical work.
rowSpecializations.O22: Analysis result production denotes the process for the exact analysis work, method, specimen/property and output specification. INTENDED_WINDOW uses PROSPECTIVE_OUTPUT_SPECIFICATION for every requested facet. PERFORMED OCCURRENCE, STARTED and IN_PROGRESS allow PENDING_OUTPUT without an actual result, or an explicitly evidenced ACTUAL_OUTPUT; neither proves completion. PERFORMED COMPLETED requires actual result/output evidence and all finish conditions. Both performed time profiles use this facet guard. Only PERFORMED_INSTANT selects MeasurementEvidence /phenomenonTime/instant; RESULT_TIME needs exact compatible work/facet meaning and never means the ordinary resultTime field or sample time.
rowSpecializations.O23: The act is importing/attaching the specified report into the named destination context from the identified source system. Intended window binds the intended report/selection and destination; no existing ingestion result is required. Performed interval describes this ingestion process, not the report subject or sampling/spray interval. STARTED commences the import, IN_PROGRESS means ongoing transfer/attachment, COMPLETED satisfies defined attachment/verification finish conditions. For performed instant only, RECORD_TIME describes an independently evidenced recording phenomenon selected at phenomenonTime/instant; capture/sync fields alone cannot prove it.

operationProfiles.eventCaseRule: The exact associated case fixes family/subtype presence, dominant consequence, selected activity/facet/work/extent and time selector before evaluation. O22 analysis-result-production and O23 report-ingestion require their own case; neither borrows collection, spraying or historical pruning. Existing V04-report-ingest can support only its actual evidenced meaning. A new exact event case remains a candidate for existing-owner adoption, not admission.
operationProfiles.qualifierRules: All five qualifiers plus omission remain available under the existing canonical activity/method semantics. OBSERVED_TIME means direct act evidence; SAMPLE_TIME collection; RESULT_TIME result production; RECORD_TIME recording; ESTIMATED_TIME explicit estimate qualification; omission only unique versioned interpretation. They are not interchangeable. Source context and result branches remain unchanged.

PROSPECTIVE_OUTPUT_SPECIFICATION.meaning: The intended output specification for this analysis work, sample, property and method. No result exists by implication, including when the requested milestone is COMPLETED.

PENDING_OUTPUT.meaning: The process is alleged to occur, start or be in progress against the exact output specification. NOT_YET_PRODUCED asserts no produced result yet; UNREPORTED asserts no result-availability fact. Neither carries an actual-result reference or supplies completion evidence.

ACTUAL_OUTPUT.meaning: An actual result is explicitly alleged and independently evidenced as output of this exact work/specification for its sample/property/method. Its existence alone does not prove STARTED, IN_PROGRESS or every finish condition.

commonPredicates: specificationBinding must equal workSpecification.outputSpecification and resolve the expected output for this exact sample, property, method and activityInstance. It is a specification binding, never a fabricated result identity.
The selected profile supplies temporal source rules independently. Actual evidence about the selected work facet is always required for performed claims; pending output does not waive that evidence.

PERFORMED COMPLETED requires ACTUAL_OUTPUT with actual result binding and independent output/provenance evidence plus every bound finish condition. PENDING_OUTPUT/PROSPECTIVE_OUTPUT_SPECIFICATION, an interval end, or a start/progress witness cannot satisfy completion.

For PERFORMED OCCURRENCE/STARTED/IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_OUTPUT is valid without an actual output. An independently existing partial/early output may instead be explicitly alleged as ACTUAL_OUTPUT, but it does not establish completion.
O22OutputContract.profilePosture: INTENDED_WINDOW requires INTENDED; PERFORMED_INSTANT/PERFORMED_INTERVAL require PERFORMED. These guards are unchanged.

atomAlgebra.definition: Exact row conceptRevision; body uses that row atomContract and parameterContract. No implicit alternate flattened form. Earlier frozen versions remain historical and are not silently accepted as current r4 atoms.
atomAlgebra.identity: atomId identifies this allegation within the claim. Operation body.activityInstance binds the exact work instance, distinct from canonical OPERATION identity; no identity is created. Repeating an activity across atoms requires that same binding explicitly, never adjacency or equal time.
atomAlgebra.scope: Every atom carries typed subject, exact profile/time and extent. Operation body.target may differ from subject only through the explicit required target relation; operation extent must equal scope.extent. Each whole-example atom repeats its outer subject/time; there is no inherited field.

composition.ALL: Nonempty children, all alleged; all independently satisfy their row contract. No metadata-only child.
composition.ANY: Nonempty alternative allegations with complete atoms and explicit separate findings.
composition.NOT: Exactly one complete child and scoped negation; lack of evidence is not negation.
composition.QUALIFIED: Exactly one complete child, appliesToAtomId equal to that child atomId; qualifiers stay on that atom and cannot alter typed target/time/quantity values. Allowed keys epistemicPosture, sourceQuality, extentQualification; any refinement must also be explicit in atom scope.
composition.SEQUENCE: Nonempty complete children and explicit orderRelations {beforeAtomId, afterAtomId, temporalRelation}; relation BEFORE means strict end/instant < start/instant. Never infer time from array position.

outcomes.scope: Candidate internal proposition/criterion interpretation only; mandatory domain/authority/evidence gates are always independent conjunctive obligations.
outcomes.ALL: TRUE iff every child TRUE; FALSE if any child FALSE; otherwise INDETERMINATE.
outcomes.ANY: TRUE if any child TRUE; FALSE iff every child FALSE; otherwise INDETERMINATE. Preserve every child finding; an OR cannot bypass a mandatory gate.
outcomes.NOT: TRUE from an evaluated FALSE child, FALSE from TRUE, INDETERMINATE from INDETERMINATE. Missing evidence is not evaluated FALSE.
outcomes.SEQUENCE: Conjunction of each alleged activity plus explicitly stated ordering comparisons; physical time is not inferred from array order.
outcomes.qualification: Apply algebra only after preserving each atom’s exact scope, time, units, uncertainty and source/method meaning. No outcome confers accepted truth.

atomAlgebra.outerObligations: The complete record still carries selectedAction, subject, sole anchor, assertion act, pending state and all applicable 49 duties. Composition does not bypass any mandatory evidence or authority gate. Outer performedBy and claimPosture must match every operation atom in this candidate single-record form; different performers/postures require linked separate claims. Atom time equals the outer subjectTime for a single atom/ALL/ANY/NOT/QUALIFIED claim. A SEQUENCE may use explicitly bounded child intervals/instants within an outer PERFORMED_INTERVAL, with each child independently binding its temporal evidence; no common-time inheritance or outer proof substitution.
atomAlgebra.workSpecification: Every operation atom binds one versioned work specification, activityInstance, procedure, target, extent and explicit start/inProgress/finish condition IDs. All selected IDs must resolve in that exact specification. COMPLETED requires every listed finish condition over the whole stated extent; partial completion must name a smaller extent. Intended facets describe requested milestones, never observed occurrence.
atomAlgebra.disclosures: Quantity disclosures are entries within the exact operation atom, keyed to activityInstance. W02 planned rate and unreported actual dose belong to its O19 instance. They are not separate O01 allegations.
atomAlgebra.sample: O10 uses OTHER_ACTION/OTHER_INTERVENTION and parameters.specificActivity=SAMPLE_COLLECTION, with sample, sampledProperty and samplingProcedure under parameters. Pending analytical result, custody and evidence posture are explicit parameters; sampling extent is scope.extent. No SAMPLE_COLLECTION alternate activity token.
